[[File:Monk's robe top detail.png|left|120px]]
'''Monk's robe top''' is a part of [[Monk's robes]] and can be found lying on the table upstairs in the [[Edgeville Monastery]], which requires a [[Prayer]] level of 31 to enter. The monk's robe top is useful in that it provides a +6 Prayer bonus while having no requirements to wear.
